paragraphs: Wendy's is primarily engaged in the business of operating, developing and franchising a system of distinctive quick-service restaurants serving high quality food. Wendy's opened its first restaurant in Columbus, Ohio in 1969. Today, Wendy's is the second largest quick-service restaurant company in the hamburger sandwich segment in the United States (the "U.S.") based on traffic and dollar share, and the third largest globally with 7,397 restaurants in the U.S. and 38 foreign countries and U.S. territories as of December 28, 2025.

At December 28, 2025, there were 5,969 Wendy's restaurants in operation in the U.S. Of these restaurants, 423 were operated by the Company and 5,546 were operated by a total of 203 franchisees. In addition, at December 28, 2025, there were 1,428 Wendy's restaurants in operation in 38 foreign countries and U.S. territories. Of the international restaurants, 1,417 were operated by a total of 117 franchisees and 11 were operated by the Company in the United Kingdom (the "U.K.").
The Company's principal executive offices are located at One Dave Thomas Blvd., Dublin, Ohio 43017, and its telephone number is (614) 764-3100.

The Wendy's Company's corporate predecessor was incorporated in Ohio in 1929 and was reincorporated in Delaware in June 1994. Effective September 29, 2008, in conjunction with the merger of Triarc Companies, Inc. and Wendy's International, Inc., the Company's corporate name was changed from Triarc Companies, Inc. to Wendy's/Arby's Group, Inc. Effective July 5, 2011, in connection with the Company's sale of Arby's Restaurant Group, Inc., the Company's corporate name was changed to The Wendy's Company.

The Company's fiscal reporting periods consist of 52 or 53 weeks ending on the Sunday closest to December 31 and are referred to herein as (1) "the year ended December 28, 2025" or "2025," (2) "the year ended December 29, 2024" or "2024," and (3) "the year ended December 31, 2023" or "2023," all of which consisted of 52 weeks.

During 2025, the Company announced Project Fresh, a comprehensive plan to drive profitable growth and long-term value across our U.S. system. The four strategic pillars of Project Fresh include (1) brand revitalization, (2) operational excellence, (3) system optimization and (4) capital allocation. These pillars are designed to drive profitable average unit volume growth and increase traffic in the U.S. by improving marketing effectiveness, menu offerings and the customer experience, and to enhance franchisee economics. Internationally, the Company's strategic priorities also include driving profitable average unit volume growth and sustaining strong net unit growth.

The Company is comprised of the following segments: (1) Wendy's U.S., (2) Wendy's International and (3) Global Real Estate & Development. Wendy's U.S. includes the operation and franchising of Wendy's restaurants in the U.S. and derives its revenues from sales at Company-operated restaurants and royalties, franchise fees and national advertising fund collections from franchised restaurants. Wendy's International includes the operation and franchising of Wendy's restaurants in countries and territories other than the U.S. and derives its revenues from sales at Company-operated restaurants and royalties, fees and advertising fund collections from franchised restaurants. Global Real Estate & Development includes real estate activity for owned sites and sites leased from third parties, which are leased and/or subleased to franchisees, and also includes our share of the income of our Canadian restaurant real estate joint venture ("TimWen"). In addition, Global Real Estate & Development earns fees from facilitating franchisee-to-franchisee restaurant transfers ("Franchise Flips") and providing other development-related services to franchisees. See Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations contained in Item 7 herein and Note 26 to the Consolidated Financial Statements contained in Item 8 herein for segment financial information.

The revenues from our restaurant business are derived from two principal sources: (1) sales at Company-operated restaurants and (2) franchise-related revenues, including royalties, franchise fees, national advertising funds contributions and rents received from Wendy's franchised restaurants.

During 2025, Wendy's opened 268 new restaurants, of which 15 were Company-operated and 253 were franchisee-operated. During 2025, Wendy's closed 111 generally underperforming restaurants, of which five were Company-operated and 106 were franchisee-operated.

Wendy's develops, operates and franchises restaurants across the globe. Traditional restaurants generally feature dine-in, carryout, drive-thru and delivery services. While most Wendy's locations are traditional restaurants, Wendy's also operates non-traditional restaurants in locations such as fuel and transportation centers, food courts and other retail locations, delivery kitchens and military bases.

Each Wendy's restaurant offers an extensive menu specializing in hamburger sandwiches and featuring chicken sandwiches, which are prepared to order with the customer's choice of toppings and condiments. Wendy's menu also includes chicken tenders and nuggets, chili, french fries, baked potatoes, salads, soft drinks, Frosty® desserts and kids' meals. In addition, Wendy's restaurants sell a variety of promotional products on a limited time basis. Wendy's also offers breakfast in the U.S. and Canada. Wendy's breakfast menu features a variety of breakfast sandwiches such as the Breakfast Baconator® and sides such as seasoned potatoes.

headings: Risks Related to Macroeconomic and Industry Conditions
Competition from other restaurant companies, as well as grocery chains and other retail food outlets, or poor customer experience at Wendy's restaurants, could hurt our brand.
Changes in discretionary consumer spending, and in consumer tastes and preferences, could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Our results can be adversely affected by unforeseen events, such as adverse weather conditions, natural disasters, hostilities, social unrest, health epidemics or pandemics or other catastrophic events.
Risks Related to Brand Perception and Value
Our success depends substantially on our corporate reputation and on the value and perception of our brand.

Our results of operations and the value and perception of our brand depend in part on the effectiveness of our marketing and advertising programs and the successful development and launch of new products.

Our inability or failure to recognize, respond to and effectively manage the impact of social or digital media could adversely impact our brand, business, results of operations and financial condition.
We may be unable to adequately protect our intellectual property, which could harm the value of our brand and hurt our business.
Food safety events or health concerns regarding our products could create negative publicity and adversely affect our brand, business and results of operations.
Risks Related to Our Business Strategy
Our predominantly franchised business model presents a number of risks.
The growth of our business is dependent, in part, on new restaurant openings, which could be affected by factors beyond our control.

We may be unable to manage effectively the acquisition and disposition of restaurants and other restaurant activity, which could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Our leasing and ownership of significant amounts of real estate exposes us to possible liabilities and losses, including liabilities associated with environmental matters.
Our international operations are subject to various risks and uncertainties and there is no assurance that our international operations will continue to be profitable.
Our current insurance may not provide adequate levels of coverage against claims that have been or may be filed.
Risks Related to Supply Chain and Labor
Changes in commodity costs and other operating costs could adversely affect our results of operations.
Shortages or interruptions in the supply or distribution of perishable food products could damage our brand and adversely affect our business and results of operations.
We do not exercise ultimate control over purchasing for our restaurant system, which could harm our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Our business could be hurt by increased labor costs or labor shortages.
Our success depends in part upon the continued succession and retention of certain key personnel and the effectiveness of our leadership and organizational structure.
Risks Related to Technology and Cybersecurity
There are risks and uncertainties associated with our digital commerce strategies, platforms and technologies.
The occurrence of cybersecurity incidents, or a deficiency in cybersecurity, could negatively impact our brand, business, results of operations and financial condition.

paragraphs: We wish to caution readers that in addition to the important factors described elsewhere in this Form 10-K, we have included below certain material factors that have affected, or in the future could affect, our actual results and could cause our actual consolidated results during fiscal 2026, and beyond, to differ materially from those expressed in or implied by any forward-looking statements made by us or on our behalf.

The market segments in which Wendy's restaurants compete are highly competitive with respect to, among other things, price and value perception, food quality and presentation, product innovation, service, convenience, digital engagement and the location and condition of the restaurant facilities. If Wendy's fails to differentiate based on our focus on high quality food or if Wendy's restaurants fail to deliver an exceptional customer experience, whether at a Company-operated or franchised restaurant, we may experience a decrease in traffic. Further, Wendy's restaurants compete with a variety of independent regional, national and global restaurants and chains. Additionally, many of our competitors have introduced lower cost value meal menu options and have employed marketing strategies that include frequent use of price discounting (including through the use of coupons and other offers), frequent promotions and significant advertising expenditures. Some of our competitors have substantially greater financial, marketing, advertising, personnel and other resources than we do, which may allow them to react to changes in consumer tastes and preferences, pricing, marketing and operational strategies better than we can and drive
higher levels of brand awareness among consumers. This competition could result in reduced revenues and loss of market share.

Moreover, new companies, including operators outside the quick-service restaurant industry, may enter market areas in which Wendy's restaurants operate and target our customer base. For example, additional competitive pressures for prepared food purchases have come from the deli or prepared foods sections of a number of major grocery store chains, as well as from convenience stores, casual dining outlets, delivery kitchens and food delivery providers. Additionally, convenience stores and retail outlets at gas stations frequently offer a wide variety of sandwiches and other prepared foods. Such competitors may have, among other things, lower operating costs, better locations, better facilities, more effective marketing and more efficient operations. Wendy's also competes with grocery chains and other retail outlets or concepts that sell food to be prepared at home. Competition with these chains and other outlets could increase based on the gap between the price of food prepared at home compared to the price of food purchased at restaurants. This increased product and price competition could put deflationary pressure on the selling price of products offered at Wendy's restaurants or lead to a decrease in traffic. All such competition may adversely affect our brand, business, results of operations and financial condition.

Adverse economic conditions or volatility or disruptions in the national and global economies, or in regions with a high concentration of Wendy's restaurants, could adversely impact our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Adverse economic conditions or volatility or disruptions in the national and global economies could result in higher unemployment rates, labor shortages, increasing or prolonged inflation and other cost pressures, rising interest rates, financial market volatility, social unrest and geopolitical conditions or conflicts and declines in consumer sentiment, income and spending. If such conditions or disruptions occur, they may result in significant declines in consumer food-away-from-home spending, shifts to lower-priced products and/or reduced traffic in Wendy's restaurants, which could adversely impact restaurant and franchisee profitability and our operational and financial results. Additionally, adverse economic conditions or disruptions in the economies in regions that contain a high concentration of Wendy's restaurants, including markets in which Company-operated restaurants are located, could also have a material adverse impact on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Of the international restaurants, 1,417 were operated by a total of 117 franchisees and 11 were operated by the Company in the U.K.

Wendy's 主要從事經營、開發與特許經營一個獨特的快速服務餐廳系統，提供高品質的食物。Wendy's 於1969年在Ohio州Columbus市開設了第一家餐廳。目前，Wendy's 是美國漢堡三明治類別中第二大的快速服務餐廳公司（"U.S.")，根據人流量與美元佔有率計算，同時在全球排名第三，截至2025年12月28日，擁有7,397家餐廳，包括美國與38個外國國家及美國屬地。
截至2025年12月28日，美國運營中的Wendy's 餐廳共有5,969家。其中，423家為本公司經營，5,546家為203家特許經營商經營。此外，截至2025年12月28日，外國國家及美國屬地運營中的Wendy's 餐廳共有1,428家。這些國際餐廳中，1,417家為117家特許經營商經營，11家為本公司在英國（"U.K.")經營。
本公司主要營業據點位於 One Dave Thomas Blvd., Dublin, Ohio 43017，電話號碼為 (614) 764-3100。

Wendy's 公司的前身於1929年在Ohio州成立，並於1994年6月在Delaware州重新註冊。自2008年9月29日起，隨著Triarc Companies, Inc.與Wendy's International, Inc.合併，本公司名稱由Triarc Companies, Inc.更名為Wendy's/Arby's Group, Inc.。自2011年7月5日起，隨著本公司出售Arby's Restaurant Group, Inc.，本公司名稱更名為The Wendy's Company。
本公司的會計期間為52或53週，結算日為最接近12月31日的星期日， herein 簡稱為（1）"截至2025年12月28日的年度"或"2025年"，（2）"截至2024年12月29日的年度"或"2024年"，（3）"截至2023年12月31日的年度"或"2023年"，所有期間均為52週。

在2025年，本公司宣佈了Project Fresh計畫，這是一個全面的計畫，旨在推動美國系統的獲利成長與長期價值。Project Fresh 的四大戰略支柱包括（1）品牌重啟、（2）運營卓越、（3）系統最佳化與（4）資本配置。這些支柱旨在推動美國系統的獲利平均單店銷售成長與增加人流量，透過提升行銷效果、餐點選擇與顧客體驗，並增強特許經營商的經濟效益。國際上，本公司的戰略優先事項也包括推動獲利平均單店銷售成長與維持強勁的淨單店成長。

本公司包含以下應報告分部：（1）Wendy's 美國、（2）Wendy's 國際與（3）全球不動產與開發。Wendy's 美國包括美國的Wendy's 餐廳經營與特許經營，其收入來自本公司經營的餐廳銷售與特許經營商的特許費、 royalties、國家廣告基金收入。Wendy's 國際包括美國以外國家與屬地的Wendy's 餐廳經營與特許經營，其收入來自本公司經營的餐廳銷售與特許經營商的特許費、 fees與廣告基金收入。全球不動產與開發包括自有與向第三方租賃的不動產活動，這些不動產被租賃與/或分租給特許經營商，也包括本公司在加拿大餐廳不動產合資企業（"TimWen"）的權益。此外，全球不動產與開發也從協助特許經營商之間的餐廳轉讓（"Franchise Flips"）與提供其他開發相關服務給特許經營商中獲取費用。請參閱 herein 第7項「管理層討論與分析財務狀況與營運成果」與第8項「合併財務報表附註」第26項中關於分部財務資訊。
我們餐廳業務的收入來自兩個主要來源：（1）本公司經營的餐廳銷售與（2）特許經營相關收入，包括 royalties、特許費、國家廣告基金貢獻與來自Wendy's 特許經營餐廳的租金收入。

Wendy's 開發、經營並特許經營全球的餐廳。傳統餐廳通常提供內用、外帶、 drive-thru 及外送服務。雖然大多數 Wendy's 經營點為傳統餐廳，Wendy's 也於如加油站與運輸中心、美食廣場及其他零售點、外送廚房及軍事基地等場所經營非傳統餐廳。

每家 Wendy's 餐廳均提供廣泛的餐點選擇，專門以漢堡三明治為主，並包含雞肉三明治，根據顧客選擇的配料與調料現點現做。Wendy's 餐點也包含雞肉柳、雞肉塊、辣椒、法式薯條、烤馬鈴薯、沙拉、軟飲料、Frosty® 甜點及兒童餐。此外，Wendy's 餐廳會在有限時間內販售多樣的促銷商品。Wendy's 並在美國與加拿大提供早餐服務。Wendy's 早餐餐點包含多樣的早餐三明治，如 Breakfast Baconator®，以及如調味馬鈴薯等配菜。

我們餐廳業務的營業收入主要來自兩個來源：(1) 本公司經營餐廳的銷售額，以及(2) 加盟相關收入，包括來自溫蒂漢堡加盟餐廳的特許經營權使用費、國家廣告基金貢獻、租金及加盟費。
溫蒂漢堡的營運成果受多項外部因素影響，包括原物料成本、人工成本、激烈價格競爭、失業率與消費者支出水平、總體經濟與市場趨勢以及天氣狀況。

2025年，本公司宣佈了Project Fresh計畫，這是一個全面的計畫，旨在推動美國系統的獲利成長與長期價值。Project Fresh的四大戰略支柱包括(1) 品牌重振、(2) 操作卓越、(3) 系統優化以及(4) 資本配置。這些支柱旨在推動美國系統的獲利平均單店銷售額成長，並透過提升行銷效果、餐點選擇與顧客體驗來增加人流量，同時提升加盟夥伴經濟效益。國際方面，本公司戰略優先事項也包括推動獲利平均單店銷售額成長，並維持強勁的淨單店成長。

headings: 與總體經濟及產業狀況相關之風險
其他餐飲公司、超市連鎖店及其他零售食品通路之競爭，或華倫達餐廳顧客體驗不佳，可能影響我司品牌。
消費者可支配支出及消費者口味與偏好之變化，可能對我司業務、營運結果及財務狀況產生不利影響。
我司營運結果可能因未預見之事件而受到不利影響，例如惡劣天氣、自然災害、敵對行動、社會動亂、健康疫情或大流行病或其他災難性事件。
與品牌觀感及價值相關之風險
我司之成功在很大程度上取決於我司企業聲譽及品牌價值與觀感。
我司營運結果及品牌價值與觀感，在一定程度上取決於我司行銷與廣告活動之成效，以及新產品之成功開發與發佈。
我司無法或未能識別、回應並有效管理社會或數位媒體之影響，可能對我司品牌、業務、營運結果及財務狀況產生不利影響。
本公司可能無法充分保護智慧財產權，這可能會損害本公司的品牌價值並影響本公司業務。
食品安全事件或有關本公司產品的健康疑慮，可能會造成負面宣傳，並不利於本公司品牌、業務及營運結果。
與本公司業務策略相關的風險
本公司以特許經營為主的業務模式會面臨許多風險。
本公司業務的成長部分取決於新餐廳開幕，而新餐廳開幕可能受到我們無法控制的因素影響。
本公司可能無法有效管理餐廳的收購與處置及其他餐廳相關活動，這可能會對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
本公司對大量實物資產的租賃及所有權會使我們面臨潛在的責任及損失，包括與環境問題相關的責任。
本公司國際業務面臨各種風險與不確定性，並無保證本公司國際業務會持續獲利。
本公司目前的保險可能無法提供足夠的保障，以應對已提出或可能提出的索賠。
與供應鏈及勞動力相關的風險
原物料成本及其他營運成本的變動可能對本公司營運成果產生不利影響。
易腐食品產品供應或分銷的短缺或中斷，可能損害本公司品牌，並對本公司業務及營運成果產生不利影響。

與本公司負債相關之風險

paragraphs: 本公司提醒讀者，除了本表單 10-K 其他地方所描述的重要因素外，本公司亦於下文列出若干重要因素，這些因素已影響或未來可能影響本公司實際結果，並可能導致本公司於財務年度 2026 年及以後的實際合併結果，與任何由本公司或代表本公司所作出的預測性陳述所表達或暗示的結果有重大差異。

溫迪餐廳所競爭的市場區隔極具競爭性，涉及價格與價值感、食品品質與呈現方式、產品創新、服務、便利性、數位參與以及餐廳設施的位址與狀態等多方面。若本公司未能透過對高品質食品的重視來區隔自身，或溫迪餐廳未能提供卓越的顧客體驗（無論為本公司經營或特許經營的餐廳），本公司可能面臨客流量減少的風險。此外，溫迪餐廳與許多獨立區域性、國家性及全球性餐廳及連鎖品牌競爭。另外，許多競爭對手已推出較低成本的價值餐點選項，並採用包含頻繁折扣（包括透過折扣券及其他優惠）、頻繁促銷及大量廣告支出的行銷策略。部分競爭對手擁有遠較本公司為多的財務、行銷、廣告、人力及其他資源，這可能使其能比本公司更有效地應對消費者口味與偏好、價格、行銷及營運策略的變化，並提升品牌知名度。
此等競爭可能導致營收減少及市場佔有率流失。

此外，新興企業，包括非速食餐廳產業的經營者，可能進入溫迪餐廳經營的市場區隔，並針對本公司顧客羣體。例如，預備餐點的購買需求已從許多大型超市連鎖的冷鮮食品區及便利商店、輕食餐廳、外送廚房及外送餐點供應商處增加。另外，便利商店及加油站零售點經常提供多樣化的三明治及其他預備餐點。這些競爭對手可能擁有較低的營運成本、更佳的位址、更佳的設施、更有效的行銷及更高效的營運。溫迪亦與超市連鎖及其他零售點或概念競爭，這些零售點銷售可在家準備的食品。與這些連鎖品牌及其他零售點的競爭可能因在家準備食品的價格與餐廳購買食品的價格之間的差距而增加。此增加的產品與價格競爭可能對溫迪餐廳所提供的產品售價造成通縮壓力，或導致客流量減少。所有這些競爭可能對本公司品牌、業務、營運結果及財務狀況產生不利影響。
國家及全球經濟或地區經濟的不利條件、波動或中斷，可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況產生不利影響。

國家及全球經濟的不利條件、波動或中斷，可能導致失業率上升、人力短缺、通貨膨脹增加或延續、其他成本壓力、利率上升、財務市場波動、社會動盪及地緣政治條件或衝突，以及消費者情緒、收入及支出下降。若發生上述條件或中斷，可能導致消費者外食支出顯著減少、轉向較低價格產品及/或溫迪餐廳客流量減少，這可能對餐廳及特許經營商的獲利及本公司營運與財務結果產生不利影響。此外，若在溫迪餐廳高度集中地區的經濟出現不利條件或中斷，包括本公司經營餐廳所在市場，也可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
